label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: U.S. Open Winds Warning
items.text: Shinnecock Hills is forecasted to bring extreme winds that could turn the 126th U.S. Open into a brutal survival test for all players this week.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Not Competing
items.text: Fifteen-time major leader Tiger Woods will not compete in the upcoming U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills this weekend.

items.headline: Patrick Reed on PGA Tour Return
items.text: Patrick Reed said he cares about PGA Tour players' opinions after leaving LIV Golf and plans to return by serving his suspension and earning his spot legitimately.
